canDo.en: I can say what I did last weekend and ask other people about their weekend, using regular and irregular past forms.
canDo.bg: Мога да разкажа какво съм правил миналия уикенд и да попитам другите за техния, като използвам правилни и неправилни глаголи в минало време.

body.en: For finished actions in the past (yesterday, last weekend, on Saturday) use the past simple. Regular verbs add -ed: watch → watched, stay → stayed. Watch the spelling: stop → stopped, study → studied. The form is the same for every person: I watched, she watched, we watched. In Bulgarian the ending changes (гледах, гледа, гледахме), but in English it never does. In questions and negatives use did / didn't + the base verb: Did you watch…? I didn't watch…
body.bg: За приключили действия в миналото (yesterday, last weekend, on Saturday) използваш past simple. Правилните глаголи получават -ed: watch → watched, stay → stayed. Внимавай с правописа: stop → stopped, study → studied. Формата е една и съща за всички лица: I watched, she watched, we watched. На български окончанието се мени (гледах, гледа, гледахме), а на английски — никога. Във въпроси и отрицания използваш did / didn't + основната форма: Did you watch…? I didn't watch…

examples: I watched a film on Saturday.
We stayed at home and cooked dinner.
She visited her grandmother last Sunday.
Did you have a nice weekend?

body.en: Many common verbs are irregular. You just learn them: go → went, have → had, buy → bought, see → saw, eat → ate, get → got, meet → met. After did and didn't, the verb goes back to its base form: I went, but I didn't go (not "didn't went"). Did you see…? (not "Did you saw…?").
body.bg: Много от най-честите глаголи са неправилни. Тях просто ги научаваш: go → went, have → had, buy → bought, see → saw, eat → ate, get → got, meet → met. След did и didn't глаголът се връща в основна форма: I went, но I didn't go (не "didn't went"). Did you see…? (не "Did you saw…?").

examples: On Saturday we went to the mountains.
I didn't go out on Sunday.

texts.title: How was your weekend?
paragraphs: Hi Lina! How was your weekend? Mine was great.
On Saturday morning I went to the market with my mum and we bought fruit and fresh bread. In the afternoon I played football in the park with my friends. We lost, but it was fun!
On Sunday it rained all day, so I stayed at home. I watched two films and cooked pasta for my family. I didn't study at all!
What did you do? Write soon! Niki

objective.en: Use a regular verb in the past simple.
objective.bg: Да използваш правилен глагол в past simple.

explanation.en: "Last Saturday" is a finished time, so we use the past simple. "Visit" is regular: add -ed → visited. In English the form doesn't change for I, you, she or we.
explanation.bg: "Last Saturday" е приключило време, затова използваме past simple. "Visit" е правилен глагол: добавяш -ed → visited. На английски формата не се мени за I, you, she или we.

hints.en: It's a regular verb. What ending does it need?
hints.bg: Правилен глагол е. Какво окончание му трябва?

objective.en: Use an irregular verb in the past simple.
objective.bg: Да използваш неправилен глагол в past simple.

items.sentence: On Sunday we ___ (go) to the cinema.

explanation.en: "Go" is irregular: the past is "went", not "goed". Irregular verbs don't take -ed — you need to learn them one by one.
explanation.bg: "Go" е неправилен глагол: миналото време е "went", а не "goed". Неправилните глаголи не получават -ed — трябва да ги научиш един по един.

hints.en: This verb is irregular. It doesn't end in -ed.
hints.bg: Този глагол е неправилен. Не завършва на -ed.

objective.en: Make a past simple question with "did".
objective.bg: Да направиш въпрос в past simple с "did".

items.prompt: Which question about last night is correct?

explanation.en: Past questions use "did" + the base verb: Did you watch…? "Did" already shows the past, so the main verb has no -ed. In Bulgarian you can just change your voice ("Гледа ли мача?"), but English needs "did" at the start.
explanation.bg: Въпросите в минало време са с "did" + основната форма на глагола: Did you watch…? "Did" вече показва миналото, затова основният глагол е без -ed. На български може само с интонация ("Гледа ли мача?"), а на английски в началото трябва "did".

hints.en: How many past forms do you need in the question?
hints.bg: Колко форми за минало време ти трябват във въпроса?

objective.bg: Да направиш отрицание в past simple.

items.sentence: I ___ (not / go) out on Friday. I was too tired.

explanation.en: The past negative is didn't (did not) + base verb: I didn't go out. Not "I wasn't go" and not "I didn't went".
explanation.bg: Отрицанието в минало време е didn't (did not) + основна форма: I didn't go out. Не "I wasn't go" и не "I didn't went".

hints.en: You need two words: the past helper + not, then the base verb.
hints.bg: Трябват ти две думи: помощният глагол в минало + not, после основната форма.

objective.bg: Да попиташ някого за уикенда му.

accept: What did you do last weekend?

explanation.en: The question word goes first, then did + you + base verb: What did you do…? Here "do" is the main verb (правя), and "did" is the helper that makes the question.
explanation.bg: Въпросителната дума е първа, после did + you + основната форма: What did you do…? Тук "do" е основният глагол (правя), а "did" е помощният, който прави въпроса.

items.prompt: Choose the correct word: "Yesterday I ___ for my English test."

explanation.en: When a verb ends in consonant + y, the y changes to i before -ed: study → studied, try → tried. But play → played, because there is a vowel before the y. "Studies" is present, not past.
explanation.bg: Когато глаголът завършва на съгласна + y, y става i пред -ed: study → studied, try → tried. Но play → played, защото пред y има гласна. "Studies" е сегашно време, а не минало.

hints.en: Look at the letter before the y.

items.prompt: Complete: "I ___ a new phone on Saturday."

explanation.en: "Buy" is irregular: buy → bought. Be careful: "brought" is the past of "bring" (нося, донасям), not "buy" (купувам). They sound similar, so many learners mix them up.
explanation.bg: "Buy" е неправилен глагол: buy → bought. Внимавай: "brought" е миналото на "bring" (нося, донасям), а не на "buy" (купувам). Звучат подобно и затова често се бъркат.

items.prompt: What did Niki do on Sunday?
options: Stayed at home and watched films

explanation.en: Niki writes: "On Sunday it rained all day, so I stayed at home. I watched two films…" Football and the market were on Saturday.
explanation.bg: Niki пише: "On Sunday it rained all day, so I stayed at home. I watched two films…" Футболът и пазарът са били в събота.

hints.en: Find the word "Sunday" in the message.

objective.en: Find a past verb in a text.
objective.bg: Да откриеш глагол в минало време в текст.

items.sentence: On Saturday afternoon, Niki ___ football with some friends.

explanation.en: Niki writes: "In the afternoon I played football in the park." "Play" is regular: played. There is a vowel before the y, so the y doesn't change.
explanation.bg: Niki пише: "In the afternoon I played football in the park." "Play" е правилен глагол: played. Пред y има гласна, затова y не се променя.

hints.en: Read the second part of the message again.
hints.bg: Прочети пак втората част на съобщението.

objective.en: Ask a friendly question about the weekend.
objective.bg: Да зададеш приятелски въпрос за уикенда.

accept: Did you have a good weekend?

explanation.en: A very common question on Monday: "Did you have a good weekend?" "Have" stays in the base form after "did" — not "Did you had…?".
explanation.bg: Много често питане в понеделник: "Did you have a good weekend?" След "did" глаголът "have" остава в основна форма — не "Did you had…?".
